{{Short description|Stream cipher algorithm}}
In [[cryptography]], '''NLS''' is a [[stream cipher]] [[algorithm]] designed by [[Gregory G. Rose|Gregory Rose]], [[Philip Hawkes]], [[Michael Paddon]], and [[Miriam Wiggers de Vries]]. It has been submitted to the [[eSTREAM]] Project of the [[eCRYPT]] network.<ref>{{cite report
